credits.title: Summer High
credits.overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

credits.title: Pilar's Diary in the Amazon
credits.overview: Young explorer Pilar travels to the Amazon through her magic net. After meeting Maiara, a riverside dweller whose community was destroyed, Pilar and her friends seek to reunite her friend's family and prevent deforestation.

credits.title: Choque de Cultura: A Série
credits.overview: The biggest names in alternative transportation reunite years after the show ended. Rogerinho is now a psychic. Renan got rich. Julinho has a death sentence hanging over him, and Maurílio created the first script.

credits.title: Quem é Morto Sempre Aparece
credits.overview: A charming con man and a debt-ridden doorman see the death of a millionaire as their chance to get rich. But the perfect scam turns into a series of disasters for the duo.

credits.title: Chuck Billy and The Marvelous Guava Tree
credits.overview: Chuck Billy has spent his life picking guavas from Jed’s guava tree. But now that Dr. Agripino is going to build a road that will take down the tree, Chuck and his friends are going to do everything they can to stop it.

credits.title: March for the Dead
credits.overview: Two grave robbers meet the spirit of the tomb they desecrated

credits.title: Cycle
credits.overview: A science fiction and suspense feature that presents a frighteningly possible future, where things got even more out of control and what would be just a "quarantine" became the new and totally bizarre normal.

credits.title: CHLOROPLAST
credits.overview: Three bored friends chat about childhood masturbation, pregnancy wishes, fatherhood and more.
